text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My name is Knight Durandal. Savor this!
This blade that cleaves through all evil!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(The sword technique I dreamed of when I was still small.
A strike like that...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I want to shine in races too.
Not just in the world of fantasy. And—)

text_block_list.name: King
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Durandal, that was magnificent!
You have my praise!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, my King.
I am honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (I want to be praised. By the one I recognized as King... to be praised and praised and praised...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I want to fill it...
To fill this heart to the brim with joy.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* Now is no time to be getting carried away.
Today is finally the day of my first visit to the castle...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I should dress in formal attire for the audience...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"So this is the Trainer's office...
The 'throne room,' so to speak."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time going in.
I wonder how extravagant a room it is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion.
The knight Durandal enters—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What is this place...? It's way more
austere than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No ornaments, no chandeliers.
And my King is not here either...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch, crunch, crunch...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As usual, I walk across the training grounds to check the condition of the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, I scoop up the dirt in my hands
to check its moisture and grain size.
It's part of my daily routine as a Trainer, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!
My King, why are you doing such yard work?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You'll get your hands dirty. Please ask a gardener,
or if there isn't one, allow me to take over...
choice_data_list: No, this is precious in its own way...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I may say so... You are a king, so please
carry yourself with a bit more dignity.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"That way, I can better devote myself
to my duties as a knight. Please consider it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Durandal.
She's the Umamusume under my charge, aiming to
run with the dashing grace of a knight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And they revere me as their 'King.'
Though, naturally, I'm not an actual king..."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, take a look at the woodchip course too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
What's this?!
To think the people around you are ordering you to do chores as well.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: To be treated with such utter disregard. It's as if—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The king of a fallen kingdom, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You are someone who by rights
deserves far more respect. However—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No one notices that potential.
Or perhaps, they are merely pretending not to.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's right! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us build a nation from scratch together.
For that cause, I, Durandal, shall do whatever it takes.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "From the races themselves, of course, to maintaining equipment and procuring provisions. And—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"With my 'Holy Sword,' I will make you
the greatest ruler of the Twinkle Series one day!
I swear it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Holy Sword" refers to
Durandal's finishing kick.
Yes, she is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite having an aptitude for sprinting, she specializes as an "end-closer"—
a truly rare kind of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, in sprint races under 1,600 meters,
you can hardly ever win without dashing right from the start.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "From here on out! Haaaahhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal is an exception among exceptions.
With just the final three furlongs,
in other words, just the 600m before the goal..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It possesses a "sharpness" like a holy sword, cleaving through everything in its path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She is truly a talent among talents. And precisely because of that, as her guardian—
choice_data_list: Someday, I'll prove I can be a worthy king!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono...
choice_data_list: Because I don't want to disappoint you!
Because I don't want to let you down!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Words too kind for me to bear... Truly, this Durandal
has been blessed with a wonderful King...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then let us march together toward
our dream of building a nation. And—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, we shall claim victory!
In this Three-Year War—
La Guerre de Trois-Ans!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: W-Was I... mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My French research should be flawless, but...
At any rate, leave it all to me!
